about.label: ABOUT
about.heading: Where code meets craft
paragraphs: I'm a developer who believes the interface is the product. Every pixel, animation, and interaction carries intent — and that intent is what separates functional software from something people genuinely enjoy using. My work lives at the intersection of engineering precision and design intuition.

I build with modern tools across the full stack, but I don't treat technology as an end in itself. The goal is always the same: ship something that works flawlessly, looks like it was cared about, and leaves the person using it better off than before. Whether it's a component library, a real-time dashboard, or a CLI tool, the bar is the same.
